definition: effect estimates or association statistics for one phenotype across matched variants
interpretation_and_caution: A vector is a statistical summary, not a person or causal mechanism.

definition: a one-to-one correspondence between vector or feature identifiers across artifacts
interpretation_and_caution: Order is not identity; normalize and validate keys before joining.

definition: geometry chosen to compare vectors or embedded points
interpretation_and_caution: The metric defines which differences count as close.

definition: changes to marginal scale before geometric analysis
interpretation_and_caution: Transformation changes geometry; it does not create independent evidence.

definition: average ranks with missing values retained during ranking
interpretation_and_caution: Freeze 3 rejects missing analysis cells before the pipeline and applies RINT column-wise before transpose.

definition: relative contrast among common distances can weaken as dimension grows
interpretation_and_caution: The phenomenon depends on distribution and norm; it is not a universal collapse theorem.

definition: projection onto directions satisfying a linear objective
interpretation_and_caution: PCA/ICA are comparators, not hidden Freeze 3 preprocessing.

definition: local graph connecting points under an input-space metric
interpretation_and_caution: Neighbor identity depends on metric, scale, k, and ties.

definition: locally calibrated edge strength in a fuzzy graph
interpretation_and_caution: This is an educational form of delegated UMAP behavior, not reimplemented code.

definition: low-dimensional layout objective balancing represented and absent fuzzy edges
interpretation_and_caution: Optimization is stochastic and coordinates are non-identifiable up to layout symmetries.

definition: additional objective encouraging agreement of local density radii
interpretation_and_caution: Density preservation trades against the base layout objective and does not make density biologically true.

definition: deterministic list controlling repeated stochastic fits
interpretation_and_caution: Recorded seeds permit replay but do not guarantee cross-platform bitwise identity.

definition: horizontal concatenation of S embeddings with q components
interpretation_and_caution: Squared Euclidean distances add across runs, so unaligned rotations/scales influence the aggregate.

definition: distance from a point to its min_samples-th neighbor
interpretation_and_caution: Larger min_samples changes the density scale and may increase unassigned points.

definition: density-aware dissimilarity used by HDBSCAN
interpretation_and_caution: It smooths single-linkage effects without removing parameter dependence.

definition: persistence of a cluster through the density hierarchy
interpretation_and_caution: The library computes the hierarchy; Freeze 3 records persistence summaries.

definition: label -1 for points unassigned under a fitted density model
interpretation_and_caution: Noise is algorithmic and parameter-conditional, never a biological-null statement.

definition: product of enumerated parameter families
interpretation_and_caution: The standard grid is 45 x 18 x 3 = 2,430 for one UMAP family.

definition: deterministic hash and ordinal for a resolved parameter combination
interpretation_and_caution: Identity supports replay; it is not a quality score.

definition: within-versus-nearest-other-cluster separation under a configured metric
interpretation_and_caution: Freeze 3 can exclude noise and supplies the configured HDBSCAN metric.

definition: between-cluster to within-cluster dispersion ratio
interpretation_and_caution: The implementation uses non-noise embedded points and Euclidean centroid geometry.

definition: average worst within/between centroid scatter ratio
interpretation_and_caution: Lower is better; Euclidean centroid assumptions can mismatch density geometry.

definition: density-based validity index
interpretation_and_caution: It is optional and supplementary under legacy_dimple, not the default score component.

definition: directed neighborhood-retention diagnostics
interpretation_and_caution: Freeze 3 computes both through directed calls to sklearn trustworthiness under Euclidean geometry.

definition: population-relative weighted combination of normalized silhouette, clusters, and optionally noise
interpretation_and_caution: Weights are raw dynamic ranges divided by their sum; final scores are min-max scaled.

definition: rules deciding which candidates receive scores and stable rank order
interpretation_and_caution: Ties resolve deterministically through configured sort keys and candidate identity.

definition: chance-adjusted pairwise partition agreement
interpretation_and_caution: Permutation invariant; a value of 1 does not imply coordinate identity.

definition: normalized information shared by two labelings
interpretation_and_caution: Normalization conventions matter; Freeze 3 uses the sklearn convention recorded in code.

definition: overlap of the two sets labeled -1
interpretation_and_caution: It isolates agreement about unassigned membership, not all clusters.

definition: residual after centering, scaling, and orthogonal alignment
interpretation_and_caution: Low disparity supports aligned coordinate similarity under the chosen transformation, not biological replication.

definition: linear association in original input dimensions
interpretation_and_caution: Post-selection descriptive only; undefined constant vectors follow configured policy.

definition: Pearson correlation of marginal ranks
interpretation_and_caution: Ties receive average ranks; monotonic association is not mechanism.

definition: reuse of discovery data for apparently confirmatory inference
interpretation_and_caution: Same-data heatmaps and correlations are descriptive; independent or selective-inference designs are needed for confirmatory claims.

definition: separate software, technical, structural, statistical, biological, external, and cross-platform evidence
interpretation_and_caution: Passing tests or exact fixture replay cannot substitute for external biological validation.

definition: dependence of finite-precision results on operation order and platform
interpretation_and_caution: Pinned dependencies improve control but do not guarantee universal bitwise equality.
